title: RNA extraction from organoids encapsulated in alginate norbornene using TRIzol Reagent
author: Helen Kearney

steps.title: Prepare Alginate Lyase Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the alginate lyase solution by dissolving 2mg of Alginate Lyase powder per 1mL of solution in PBS or 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 6.3).

substeps.instruction: Invert to mix or gently vortex.
Sterile filter the solution using a 0.2 µm pore filter and syringe.
Store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.
Warm in a 37°C water bath before use.

steps.title: Collect Organoids and Calculate Volume
steps.instruction: Transfer organoids encapsulated in alginate norbornene hydrogel into an Eppendorf tube (preferably a 1.5 mL tube with a tapered bottom).

substeps.instruction: Calculate total hydrogel volume by multiplying the number of organoids by the volume of gel each is encapsulated in (e.g., 10 organoids x 20 μL = 200 μL).

steps.title: Digest Alginate Hydrogel
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 20 U/mL alginate lyase solution to the total hydrogel volume in each Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in a 37 °C water bath for 10–15 min.
Invert the tube to check digestion progress; only cell pellet/free-spheroids/free-organoids should be visible at the bottom.

steps.title: Recover and Wash Organoids
steps.instruction: Gather the cells/spheroids/organoids and remove the enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Spin down at 300 g for 1 min.
Remove the alginate lyase solution. If hydrogel is not completely dissolved, replace with fresh solution and repeat digestion and centrifugation steps.
Wash organoids twice with PBS, spinning down at the same speed setting used previously.

steps.title: Lyse Organoids with TRIzol
steps.instruction: Retrieve samples, place on ice, and add 1 mL TRIzol to each sample (adjust volume relative to sample size: recommended 1 mL per 50–100 mg tissue or 1 × 10^7 cells).

substeps.instruction: Choose one homogenization method: Option 1: Use a 20-gauge needle and 3 mL syringe with luer lock to aspirate and dispense the sample 3–4 times; Option 2: Transfer to homogenization tubes and homogenize at 500 rpm for 15 sec on a homogenizer (e.g., Precellys Evolution Touch), placing samples on ice between runs to avoid overheating.

steps.title: Homogenize and Phase Separate
steps.instruction: Process the homogenized samples to separate RNA.

substeps.instruction: If not processing immediately, store at 4 °C overnight or –20 °C for up to 1 year.
Incubate homogenized samples at room temperature for 5 min while setting the centrifuge to 4 °C.
Add 200 µL chloroform (1:5 ratio relative to TRIzol), shake by hand for 30 sec, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 15,000 g for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Extract Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Isolate the RNA-containing aqueous phase into fresh tubes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh RNase-free Eppendorf tubes and add 1 µL glycogen blue to each.
Carefully remove tubes from the centrifuge without disturbing the phases.
Using a 200 µL pipette, transfer the clear upper aqueous phase into the tubes containing Glycogen Blue.
Add 500 µL molecular grade isopropanol (1:2 ratio relative to TRIzol volume).
Shake by hand for 30 sec and incubate at –20 °C for 1–4 h.
Centrifuge at 15,000 g for 20–25 min at 4°C.
Carefully remove all supernatant without disturbing the (light blue) RNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash and Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet to remove contaminants and dry it.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL ice-cold 75% molecular grade ethanol to the pellet and shake by hand for 10–15 sec.
Centrifuge at 7,500 g for 8 min at 4 °C.
Repeat the ethanol wash (add 600 µL ethanol, shake, centrifuge) for a purer product.
Remove all liquid and air-dry the pellet for 10–15 min, ensuring no ethanol remains on tube edges but avoiding over-drying.

steps.title: Final RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Dissolve the RNA or store the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Either proceed to extraction or snap-freeze samples in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.
Add 20 µL nuclease-free water to dissolve the pellet; keep the product chilled on ice.
If RNA does not dissolve, incubate on a heat block at 60 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA yield and purity using a Spectrometer (for A260/A280 and A260/A230 ratios) or a Fluorometer (for accurate quantification of low yields).
